title: Clover Store for Android v1.5 — More to discover
body:
A bigger, cleaner Clover Store is on its way. Building on v1.3.4, version 1.5 is planned to bring a refreshed Woods Studio interface, smoother navigation and layouts that adapt to phones and tablets.

Meet the makers through developer cards and profile pages, explore app collections, follow developers and find applications with improved search, filters and sorting. Redesigned app pages will put your Android download first, with other platforms under Other Downloads, alongside richer release information and shared community reviews.

Keep favourites close with an expanded Library, recently viewed apps and saved-app import/export. New comparison and release-tracking tools will help you explore your options and follow published updates.

Download improvements are planned to include clearer progress and failure information, queue controls and APK details. Android will continue to control installation permissions and confirmation.

Make Clover Store yours with appearance, spacing, text-size and motion controls. Settings will also include Disclaimers explaining privacy, permissions, third-party sources and your data controls.

The catalogue will continue checking GitHub for published changes every 30 seconds while the store is open. Features remain subject to Android testing and release readiness. Account sync, automatic cross-device delivery and the dedicated developer publishing website are separate services still in development.
